name: PHIL 3225W
title: Analysis and Ordinary Language
description: The reaction, after Russell, against formal theories and the belief in an ideal language, and the turn to familiar common-sense "cases" and everyday language in judging philosophical claims. Russell, Moore, Wittgenstein, Ryle and Strawson.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; at least one from PHIL 2210, 2221 or 2222.
